BYU Management Society
Africa Business Plan Competition
2026
YOUR BUSINESS NAME
JIDEOFOR RAYMOND ENTERPRISE
Increasing Sales Through Alternative 
Trade.
•utilizing market dynamics of Alternative Trade.
•Linking  both distributors and retailers.
•Sourcing the right products for my targeted retailers.
• Delivering at the door steps of the retailers at required time.
●  Maximising profit through quality sales services.

Delivering to my customers using my Van

Products that i sale in the Market.

Problem/Customer Pain Point
● Lack of quality and affordable products in the rural Riverine areas of PortHarcourt, Rivers State.
● Bridging the gap of market inadequate distribution channels.
● Creating direct sales to retailers that bypasses some layers of traditional distribution.
●  Improve market penetration and reduce costs associated with intermediaries. 
● Sourcing the right products needed by retailers.
● Reaching all categories of retailers from table top retailer to medium shop size owner.
● Reducing the cost of logistics and maintaining good customer relationship..
● Rewarding customer loyalty within intervals across all customer ranges.
● Increasing market penetration and accessibility  worsened by the limited access to modern retail outlets by 
using my Van.
1. About 32% of riverine retailers can not access the needed goods they want to sale to their customers.
2. Providing alternative means and selling directly to this retailers to without them coming to the city to buy.
3. Playing the right middle man between distributors and retailers thereby bypassing wholesalers.
Business Venture, Product or Services
Beating the pushbacks, Accelerating growth through:
● Harnessing digital innovation. ( Using my phone to register my customers and obtain what they want to buy in real time)
● To reduce the cost of goods and services by eliminating traditional distribution barriers. ( i sale to retailers directly)
● we aim to offer cost-effective, scalable, and sustainable trade solutions that address the current limitations in Nigeria's traditional 
trade infrastructure.
Startup Costs : 5.9 million naira.that is approximately $3,900 ( operational and logistics costs included)
Revenue Projections
● Year 1: 900,000 naira
● Year 2:  2,600,000 naira
● Year 3: 3,000,000 naira
I anticipate breaking even in Year 2, assuming steady growth in platform adoption and transaction volume speeds up a beat with much market 
demands and product availability.

Market Size and Growth
Target Market: Rural groceries stores, and  Suburban/rural markets.
Customer Needs: Focusing on groceries and Home use articles.
Competition:  Trade Depot Market, Open sales market, and Online purchase.
Market Trends: Age, values, purchasing strength.
Competitors. Strength                           Weakness.
                       Investment capitals.        Logistics.
                      Access to loans.             Competitive  Pricing.
                      Rebates.                           Poor customer networking.
With over 2.5 million retail shops in Port-Harcourt, Rivers State, Our expansion into  alternative trade channels positions us at the intersection of digital innovation and cultural relevance. With the right local partnerships with distributors  we aim to capture retail market share with profit above 4.8 million naira quarterly and build a strong, loyal customer base across Port-Harcourt.

Marketing and Sales Strategy
1. Creative Low-Budget Tactics.
● Offering my customers discounts on cash payment to enable me restock quickly to sale to others.
● I also run giveaways on selected goods.
2. Sales Outreach & Networking.
I ensure i meet my customer visitation targets and registration of new outlets within my coverage areas.
I reward for new customer referrals by giving out little promotion material like buckets, pen, and exercise books.
3. Utilizing improved logistics.
Using my Van in dropping goods at customer door steps, thereby ensuring core retailing.
Meeting delivery time of Purchase Order.
